payload.summary: All ten frontier nodes state paper-used definitions or genuinely distinct support results at an appropriate strength. The pair/badness and powerset characterization follow the paper's Rado discussion, the Rado order and relational embedding formalize the embedding target, and the finite-cardinality front and homogeneous triple/quadruple results support the Ramsey steps. No frontier node is merely a wrapper for a single importing node.
